description: This source file contains cryptographic verification functions related to SSL/TLS, specifically ASN.1/DSS and RSA signature verification. It provides API functions `AnscCryptoPubSSLeayDSAVerify` and `AnscCryptoPubSSLeayRSAVerifyWithType`, which currently contain stub implementations that do not perform actual verification but return fixed status values.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubSSLeayDSAVerify(PVOID pDataToVerify,ULONG ulSizeOfData,PVOID pSignature,ULONG ulSizeOfSignature,PANSC_CRYPTO_PUB_KEY_PARAMS pParams)
methods.description: Stub function to verify a DSA signature. Currently unimplemented; always returns failure.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubSSLeayRSAVerifyWithType(int nHashMethod,PVOID pDataToVerify,ULONG ulSizeOfData,PVOID pSignature,ULONG ulSizeOfSignature,PANSC_CRYPTO_PUB_KEY_PARAMS pParams)
methods.description: Stub function to verify an RSA signature with specified hash type. Currently unimplemented; always returns success.
